#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Half {
    long long match;
    long long value;

    Half() : match(0), value(0) {}
    Half(long long m, long long v) : match(m), value(v) {}

    bool operator<(const Half& o) const {
        return value < o.value;
    }
};

vector<vector<long long>> ways;

bool nextCombination(vector<int>& a, int n) {
    int k = a.size();
    int ptr = k - 1;
    while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
        ptr--;
    }
    if (ptr < 0) {
        return false;
    }
    a[ptr]++;
    for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
        a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
    }
    return true;
}

long long choose(int n, int k) {
    if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) {
        return ways[n][k];
    }
    return 0;
}

bool test(int mask, int i) {
    return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
}

long long getWins(const vector<char>& s, int r, int c) {
    int curA = 0, curB = 0;
    long long ret = 0;
    for (char cc : s) {
        if (cc == 'A') {
            curA++;
        } else {
            ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
            curB++;
        }
    }
    return ret;
}

long long slow(int r, int c, const string& s) {
    vector<int> as(r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i < r + c; i++) {
        as[i] = i;
    }
    long long totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];

    vector<char> buf(2 * (r + c), 'B');

    long long bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
    long long ans = 0;

    vector<string> good;

    do {
        std::fill(buf.begin(), buf.end(), 'B');
        for (int pos : as) {
            buf[pos] = 'A';
        }
        int match = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
            if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
                match = 0;
                break;
            }
        }
        long long winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
        long long diff = std::abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            good.clear();
            if (match == 1)
                good.push_back(std::string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
            ans = match;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += match;
            if (match == 1)
                good.push_back(std::string(buf.begin(), buf.end()));
        }
    } while (nextCombination(as, 2 * (r + c)));
    return ans;
}

struct F {
    long long totalWays;
    long long bestDiff;
    long long ans;

    int r, c;
    string s;

    vector<vector<int>> cnt;
    long long maskA, maskB;
    long long lastA, lastB;

    vector<vector<Half>> fst, snd;
    vector<int> sz;

    void preCalc() {
        ways.assign(61, vector<long long>());
        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
            ways[i].resize(i + 1);
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        long long totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        long long diff = std::abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        long long delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        std::sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
                arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                if (sz < (int)arr.size()) arr[sz] = arr[i];
                sz++;
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz);
        return arr;
    }

    void solve() {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        cnt.assign(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
            cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1LL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1LL << i;
            }
        }

        lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

        int maxMask = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < maxMask; i++) {
            int btc = __builtin_popcount(i);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            for (int j = 0; j <= c + 1; j++) {
                sz[j] = (int)ways[c + 1][j];
            }
            int idx_btc = --sz[btc];

            int samePref = std::min(__builtin_ctz((i & 1) == 0 ? i : (i + 1)), c + 1);
            int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
            int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];

            if ((i & 1) == 0) {
                totalA += samePref;
            } else {
                totalB += samePref;
            }

            long long winsA = 0;
            int curA = 0, curB = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k <= c; k++) {
                if (test(i, k)) {
                    winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                    curB++;
                } else {
                    curA++;
                }
            }

            int exactMatch = 1;
            for (int k = samePref; k <= c; k++) {
                if ((!test(i, k) && s[2 * r - 2 + k] == 'B') || (test(i, k) && s[2 * r - 2 + k] == 'A')) {
                    exactMatch = 0;
                    break;
                }
            }

            {
                int maskVal = i;
                int matchFlag = 1;
                if (((~maskVal) & lastB) != 0) {
                    matchFlag = 0;
                }
                if ((maskVal & lastA) != 0) {
                    matchFlag = 0;
                }
                long long winsA2 = 0;
                int curA2 = btc, curB2 = compBtc;
                for (int k = 0; k <= c; k++) {
                    if (test(maskVal, k)) {
                        winsA2 += ways[r - 1 + curB2][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA2, r);
                        curB2++;
                    } else {
                        curA2++;
                    }
                }
                snd[btc][idx_btc] = Half(matchFlag, winsA2);
            }

            {
                int matchFlag = 1;
                if (((~i) & lastB) != 0) {
                    matchFlag = 0;
                }
                if ((i & lastA) != 0) {
                    matchFlag = 0;
                }
                long long winsA2 = 0;
                int curA2 = btc, curB2 = compBtc;
                for (int k = 0; k <= c; k++) {
                    if (test(i, k)) {
                        winsA2 += ways[r - 1 + curB2][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA2, r);
                        curB2++;
                    } else {
                        curA2++;
                    }
                }
                fst[btc][idx_btc] = Half(matchFlag, winsA2);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        long long halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            vector<Half> one = compress(fst[i]);
            vector<Half> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);
            int ptr = (int)two.size() - 1;
            for (const auto& a : one) {
                while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + two[ptr].value > halfTotal) {
                    ptr--;
                }
                if (ptr >= 0) {
                    update(a, two[ptr]);
                }
                if (ptr + 1 < (int)two.size()) {
                    update(a, two[ptr + 1]);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    void run() {
        preCalc();
        r = nextInt();
        c = nextInt();
        s = nextToken();
        totalWays = 0;
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;
        solve();
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (st.empty()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(cin, line)) throw runtime_error("EOF");
            stringstream ss(line);
            string token;
            while (ss >> token) {
                st.push(token);
            }
        }
        string res = st.front();
        st.erase(st.begin());
        return res;
    }

    vector<Half> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        std::sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
        int sz = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)arr.size(); i++) {
            if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
                arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
            } else {
                if (sz < (int)arr.size()) arr[sz] = arr[i];
                sz++;
            }
        }
        arr.resize(sz);
        return arr;
    }

    F() {
        preCalc();
        run();
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    F solver;
    return 0;
}
